title: Lateral flow test for detecting antibiotics in the blood to prevent infection during implant procedures
summary: Infectious diseases are prevented through perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis (PAP) or treated with antibiotics. The concentration of antibiotics in the blood always plays a key role in their effectiveness. Currently, such concentration measurements using immunodiagnostic tests are performed exclusively through blood analyses conducted in specialized laboratories, which means that a long wait between sample collection and test results is unavoidable. The therapeutic level of an administered antibiotic could be determined quickly and on-site during surgery using antibody-based lateral flow tests (LFTs). However, such LFTs are currently not available on the market.  The goal of the project is to explore a rapid test that, in accordance with the point-of-care testing approach, quickly confirms the presence of antibiotic prophylaxis during implantations, thereby preventing infections during surgery and protecting patients.
